about.text: For a BIM manager checking a handover: which classes of element are missing the parameters the handover needs? The list is the required node: fourteen COBie-style fields (type reference, marks, manufacturer, asset identifier, serial number, barcode, installation and warranty dates, Uniformat and OmniClass codes, fire rating, external, load-bearing); edit it to match your own handover requirements. A parameter counts as filled when its value is not empty and is not the template placeholder that repeats the parameter's own name: this Duplex carries 'SerialNumber' = 'SerialNumber' on 211 elements, which is a blank template field, not data. FillRate in the coverage table is the share of a class's elements whose value is filled. A parameter that no element of a class carries is left out, so it shows blank in the matrix and the heatmap, not 0%: blank means 'the class never has this field', 0% means 'the field is there but empty'. Each element's own Completeness is the share of its class's carried handover fields that it fills; the 3D view (colored) paints it red (0) to green (1) on the scale shared with classChart, which ranks classes worst first. The four IfcMember stair parts carry none of the fourteen fields, so their Completeness is blank and they stay grey; the two stair flights carry only Reference and fill it, so they read 100% from one field. On this file 543 of 2,157 element-field cells are filled (25%); footings and spaces are worst at 0%, doors and windows best among the large classes at 38%. Elements are every rooted, placed product in the file (239: types, styles, openings and spatial containers excluded); Storey comes from walking the containment and aggregation links up to the IfcBuildingStorey. The Vega-Lite spec (specs/viz-parameter-completeness.vl.json) draws the heatmap from the coverage table: Parameter across, Class down, FillRate as colour.

elements.sql: SELECT EntityIndex, GlobalId, StepId, Name, Category AS Class FROM t WHERE coalesce(GlobalId, '') <> '' AND Category NOT IN ('IFCPROJECT', 'IFCSITE', 'IFCBUILDING', 'IFCBUILDINGSTOREY', 'IFCOPENINGELEMENT') AND NOT regexp_matches(Category, '(TYPE|STYLE|PROPERTIES)$') ORDER BY EntityIndex

storeys.sql: WITH RECURSIVE up(EntityIndex, Parent, Depth) AS (SELECT EntityIndexA, EntityIndexB, 1 FROM t2 WHERE RelationType IN ('ContainedIn', 'MemberOf') UNION ALL SELECT up.EntityIndex, r.EntityIndexB, up.Depth + 1 FROM up JOIN t2 r ON r.EntityIndexA = up.Parent AND r.RelationType IN ('ContainedIn', 'MemberOf') WHERE up.Depth < 4) SELECT up.EntityIndex, arg_min(s.Name, up.Depth) AS Storey FROM up JOIN t1 s ON s.EntityIndex = up.Parent AND s.Category = 'IFCBUILDINGSTOREY' GROUP BY up.EntityIndex ORDER BY up.EntityIndex

cells.sql: WITH carried AS (SELECT p.EntityIndex, p.Name AS Parameter, max(CASE WHEN trim(coalesce(p.Value, '')) <> '' AND lower(replace(p.Value, ' ', '')) <> lower(replace(p.Name, ' ', '')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Filled FROM t2 p JOIN t3 r ON r.Parameter = p.Name GROUP BY p.EntityIndex, p.Name), applicable AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.Class, c.Parameter FROM carried c JOIN t1 e ON e.EntityIndex = c.EntityIndex) SELECT e.EntityIndex, e.GlobalId, e.Class, e.Storey, a.Parameter, coalesce(c.Filled, 0) AS Filled FROM t1 e JOIN applicable a ON a.Class = e.Class LEFT JOIN carried c ON c.EntityIndex = e.EntityIndex AND c.Parameter = a.Parameter ORDER BY e.EntityIndex, a.Parameter

coverage.aggregates: count(*) as Elements, sum(Filled) as FilledElements, avg(Filled) as FillRate

matrix.title: Handover fill rate per class (blank: the class never carries the field)

scores.aggregates: count(*) as Applicable, sum(Filled) as FilledFields, avg(Filled) as Completeness

byClass.aggregates: count(*) as Elements, avg(Completeness) as Completeness

classChart.title: Mean handover completeness per class, worst first
